failures_and_surprises.title: Port-8000 false-positive readiness trap in five validate scripts
failures_and_surprises.detail: phase07/08/09/10/21 all poll http://127.0.0.1:8000/health and break out on the first 200. On this host port 8000 already returns {"status":"ok","version":"0.2.0"} from the Aether PRODUCTION API (uvicorn, pid 5505). The gate therefore passes instantly against a foreign service, and the subsequent assertions 404. The scripts also try to bind :8000 themselves, colliding with a guardian-owned production service and violating orchestration contract §3.6.
